doc: Stage-4 de-shifted forward C4: functional = int_0^oo chi(nu) Psi_{4,nu} dnu, Psi normalised so that its leading-Regge heavy image is sum_j R_j(nu) P_{-1/2+i(nu - i j)}(cosh beta) (R_j below; h_j = N_com R_j, N_com absorbed in chi). chi_value: image P_{-1/2}(cosh beta) (= C^_4(0)); chi_deriv: image d_{nu^2}P|_0 (= d_{nu^2} C^_4(0)). Midpoint grid nu_k = (k+1/2) dnu. min-norm gauge of the chi-normalised Abel operator (3 null directions). See RESULT_Q_STAGE4.md.
